**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is preparing for an event and is associated with a company named XYZ Inc.

[PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on influencer marketing strategies and event marketing strategies.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised on following up with leads after an event, recommending timely follow-up, personalizing the approach, segmenting leads, offering additional value, using multi-channel outreach, setting clear next steps, and tracking effectiveness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested additional tips for event marketing, including using event technology, creating a lead scoring system, developing a post-event survey, and assigning a dedicated follow-up team.
